import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

plan = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_round3_batch_plan.json').read_text())
source = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_train/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py')
assert file_sha256(source) == plan['source_sha256']
text = source.read_text()
calls = [n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(text)) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
         and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'write_text'
         and isinstance(n.func.value, ast.Name) and n.func.value.id == 'core']
assert len(calls) == 1
core = ast.literal_eval(calls[0].args[0])
old, new = "'--seed', '0'", "'--seed', '1'"
assert core.count(old) == 1
updated = core.replace(old, new)
assert text.count(repr(core)) == 1
folder = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_seed1')
folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
target = folder / source.name
target.write_text(text.replace(repr(core), repr(updated)))
metadata = json.loads(source.with_name('kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
metadata.update(id=metadata['id']+'-seed1', title=metadata['title']+' seed 1')
assert metadata['is_private']
(folder / 'kernel-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2)+'\n')
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'register an independent training-seed replication before either new outcome'}, plan['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status':'registered_before_outcomes',
          'primary_plan':'results/training/qwen38_round3_batch_plan.json',
          'primary_source_sha256':file_sha256(source), 'replication_source_sha256':file_sha256(target),
          'source_commit':plan['source_commit'], 'seed':1, 'metadata':metadata,
          'change':'Only the embedded command seed changes from 0 to 1. Keep exact primary core, package payload, model revision, recipe, optimizer schedules, checkpoints and environment. The retained generator identifies the producing commit and byte transformation.',
          'training_command':['kaggle','kernels','push','-p',str(folder),'--accelerator','NvidiaTeslaT4','--timeout','41400'],
          'admission':'Submit only after the primary saved batch reports RUNNING and official available quota is at least 63,000 seconds: 41,400 session cap plus 21,600 reserved for primary validation/test. At most two concurrent batch sessions.',
          'evaluation':'Validation only: both SFT and GRPO on all 100 common seeds 80000-80099 per game with serial inference, subject to measured remaining quota. Report all outcomes, including partials/failures. Same max-min score is descriptive; never use seed 1 to replace the registered seed-0 test winner.',
          'test_policy':'No seed-1 held-out evaluation is authorized by this registration. Primary nine-candidate family and seed-0 SFT/GRPO selection remain unchanged.',
          'hypothesis':'Repeat the exact recipe with a different training random seed to expose training instability rather than promoting only the best run. Two seeds cannot establish a precise population-level training-seed confidence interval.'}
Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
compile(target.read_text(),str(target),'exec')
compile(updated,'seed1_core','exec')
print({'seed':1,'private':metadata['is_private'],'source_sha256':file_sha256(target),'only_seed_changed':updated.replace(new,old)==core})
change: Only the embedded command seed changes from 0 to 1. Keep exact primary core, package payload, model revision, recipe, optimizer schedules, checkpoints and environment. The retained generator identifies the producing commit and byte transformation.
admission: Submit only after the primary saved batch reports RUNNING and official available quota is at least 63,000 seconds: 41,400 session cap plus 21,600 reserved for primary validation/test. At most two concurrent batch sessions.
evaluation: Validation only: both SFT and GRPO on all 100 common seeds 80000-80099 per game with serial inference, subject to measured remaining quota. Report all outcomes, including partials/failures. Same max-min score is descriptive; never use seed 1 to replace the registered seed-0 test winner.
test_policy: No seed-1 held-out evaluation is authorized by this registration. Primary nine-candidate family and seed-0 SFT/GRPO selection remain unchanged.
hypothesis: Repeat the exact recipe with a different training random seed to expose training instability rather than promoting only the best run. Two seeds cannot establish a precise population-level training-seed confidence interval.
